title: Contractual Senior Resident and Full Time/Part Time Contractual Specialists
salary_range: Entry pay level 11 with basic pay of Rs 67,700/- plus allowances
age_limit: Senior Resident: Not exceeding 45 years; Specialist: Not exceeding 67 years as on the date of interview.
summary: ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri, Bhopal is conducting a walk-in interview on 04th December 2026 to fill 37 contractual vacancies for Senior Residents (3 years tenure) and Full Time/Part Time Contractual Specialists. Interested candidates meeting the educational qualifications must report for document verification between 9:15 AM and 11:00 AM on the interview date.
eligibility_bullets: Senior Resident: MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma or MBBS with 2 years working experience in the same discipline.
Specialist: MBBS and PG Degree with 3 years work experience or Diploma with 5 years work experience, registered with Medical Council of India or State Medical Council.
Age limit: Up to 45 years for Senior Residents and up to 67 years for Specialists as on date of interview, with relaxation as per DOPT rules.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Full Time / Part Time Contractual Specialist

how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form from the official website www.esic.gov.in.
Fill out the application form in block letters and attach self-attested copies of required documents and 2 passport size photographs.
Report for document verification and walk-in interview between 9:15 AM and 11:00 AM at the Administration Office, Ground Floor, ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri, Bhopal on 04th December 2026.
